pages.text: Meteorites are the starting point for using AE2. They provide critical materials: $(l:items_blocks_machines/budding_certus)budding certus blocks$(/l) of various types and a $(l:items_blocks_machines/mysterious_cube)Mysterious Cube$(/l) in the center.$(br2)$(l:getting_started/getting_started)Getting Started$(/l) will provide info on what to do once you find one.

pages.title: Finding Meteorites
pages.text: Meteorites are fairly common and leave massive holes in the ground, so you may have already found a few. if not, a $(l:items_blocks_machines/meteorite_compass)Meteorite Compass$(/l) will point toward the nearest mysterious cube.
